tha-ap433:1.1: Sakiṃsammajjakavaggo tecattāriso. XLIV [428. Ekavihāriya.] Imamhi bhaddake kappe brahmabandhu mahāyaso / Kassapo nāma gottena uppajji vadataṃ varo. // //
tha-ap433:2.1: Nippapañco nirālambo ākāsasamamānaso / puññatā-bahulo tādi animittarato vasī // //
tha-ap433:3.1: Asaṅgacitto nikleso asaṃsaṭṭho kule gaṇe / mahākāruṇiko vīro vinayopāyakovido. // //
tha-ap433:4.1: Uyyutto parakiccesu vinayanto sadevake / nibbānagamanaṃ maggaṃ gatipaṅkavisosanaṃ // //
tha-ap433:5.1: Amataṃ param-assādaṃ jarāmaccunivāraṇaṃ / mahāparisamajjhe so nisinno lokatāraṇo. // //
tha-ap433:6.1: Karavīkarudo nātho brahmaghoso Tathāgato / uddharanto mahāduggā vippanaṭṭhe anāyake. // //
tha-ap433:7.1: Desento virajaṃ dhammaṃ diṭṭho me lokanāyako / tassa dhammaṃ suṇitvāhaṃ pabbajiṃ anagāriyaṃ. // //
tha-ap433:8.1: Pabbajitvā tadā vāhaṃ cintento jinasāsanaṃ / ekako pavane ramme vasiṃ saṃsaggapīḷito. // //
tha-ap433:9.1: Savkāyaūpakaṭṭho me hetubhūto mam āgami / manaso vūpakaṭṭhassa saṃsaggabhayadassino.
tha-ap433:13.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Ekavihāriyo thero i. g. a-ti.
